recommendation.note: Request changes. The app has no LICENSE file, which is a hard gate criterion for catalog listing. All other aspects are sound: the README is detailed (architecture, troubleshooting, model catalog management), the Batch Connect layout is correct, all shell scripts pass syntax checking, security findings are low-to-medium severity and either intentional (advanced user fields) or architectural (0.0.0.0 proxy binding required for OOD routing), and the repo is active. Once a license is added, the remaining issues — documentation below Adequate (missing prerequisites and configuration sections) and portability improvements (the /gpfs/ paths in form.yml and template/ need updating at every new site) — put this in "Accept with suggestions" territory, conditional on the catalog duplicate check passing. This assessment is also conditional on the catalog duplicate and software-entry checks noted above, which could not be performed.

assessments.documentation_summary: Strong architecture and troubleshooting sections; no prerequisites or configuration section prevents reaching Adequate
assessments.portability_summary: Site-specific /gpfs/ paths and cluster name centralized in form.yml; README documents model catalog and deployment
